title: ATP Escalation Event
description: Structured record of an escalation trigger with full context snapshot for the receiving authority.

trigger_text.description: The exact escalation rule text from the protocol that fired

severity.description: info=awareness only, no action required. warn=action recommended, non-blocking. critical=halt, action required before proceeding.

execution_phase.description: Which phase of the ATP loop triggered this escalation. Canonical phase list is defined in the root SPEC.md.

context_snapshot.description: State at the time of escalation

last_action.description: Description of the last action taken before escalation triggered

routed_to.description: Role or agent ID this escalation is directed to

requires_ack.description: If true, execution must halt until acknowledgment is received
